data.body_html:
Planning a hen party in Marbella for 2027? A private yacht charter from Puerto Banús offers the ultimate celebration: sun, sea, and style. But the food and drinks can make or break the vibe. From champagne brunches to Spanish feasts, our Marbella hen party yacht catering ideas 2027 guide covers menus, themes, and practical tips to ensure your group enjoys every moment. All our charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT — so you can focus on the party.

Why Choose a Yacht for Your Hen Party in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline is perfect for a floating celebration. Depart from Puerto Banús, cruise past the Golden Mile, and anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim. With a private yacht, you control the music, the itinerary, and the catering. No crowded bars, no queues — just 360° views of the Mediterranean and the Sierra Blanca mountains. Our fleet ranges from 6.4m speedboats to 29m luxury yachts, accommodating 5 to 12 guests. For 2027, we’ve curated catering packages that match every theme.

Standard Inclusions: What’s Already on Board?

Every charter comes with a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts), insurance, and Spanish IVA (21%). This is your base. For a hen party, you’ll likely want to upgrade. The standard snacks are perfect for a short 2-hour cruise, but for a 4- or 8-hour party, consider a bespoke menu.

Top Catering Ideas for a 2027 Hen Party

1. Champagne Brunch

Start the day with a luxury brunch: fresh pastries, fruit platters, yoghurt, and a chilled bottle of cava or champagne. Upgrade to a premium champagne package (Moët or Veuve Clicquot) on request. Best paired with a morning departure (10:00–14:00).

2. Spanish Tapas Feast

Nothing says Marbella like jamón ibérico, manchego cheese, patatas bravas, gambas al ajillo, and tortilla española. Our team can arrange a tapas spread delivered to the boat. Add a pitcher of sangria for a local touch. Ideal for a 4-hour afternoon charter.

3. Paella on Board

For a true Spanish experience, order a paella valenciana or seafood paella cooked fresh and brought to the yacht. Served with a crisp Albariño or a cold beer, this is a crowd-pleaser. Works well for a lunch cruise (13:00–17:00).

4. Sushi & Ceviche Bar

Light, fresh, and Instagram-worthy. A sushi and ceviche platter is perfect for a hot day. Pair with a dry rosé or sparkling water. Great for a chic, modern hen party.

5. BBQ on Deck

Some of our larger yachts (e.g., Mangusta 80, Azimut 58) can accommodate a BBQ setup. Think grilled prawns, chicken skewers, corn on the cob, and salads. Requires advance notice and a minimum 4-hour charter.

Popular Themes for 2027 Hen Parties

Themes add structure to your catering. Here are three trending ideas:

  • White Party: All-white dress code, champagne, and a light menu (ceviche, fruit, white wine).
  • Ibiza Boat Party: DJ setup, glow sticks, and a cocktail bar (mojitos, gin and tonics).
  • Flamenco Fiesta: Spanish tapas, sangria, and a flamenco dancer (optional extra).

For groups of 10–12, the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 are top choices. For smaller groups (5–8), the Bandido or Speedboat work well. All depart from Puerto Banús.

How to Book Catering Upgrades

Catering upgrades are not included in the base price. Contact us via WhatsApp with your group size, preferred date, and menu requests. We’ll provide a quote and coordinate with local caterers. All extras must be arranged at least 48 hours in advance. Pricing is on request — no hidden fees.

Tips for a Flawless Hen Party Day

  • Book early: 2027 weekends fill fast, especially in June–September.
  • Communicate dietary needs: Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free options are available.
  • Plan your itinerary: Typical routes include Puerto Banús → Cabopino → Cala del Faro → Marbella Marina.
  • Bring sunscreen and towels: The sun is strong; we provide shade but bring SPF 50.
  • Music system: All yachts have Bluetooth speakers; bring your playlist.

Frequently asked questions

Standard charters include light snacks, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. For a hen party, you can upgrade to a full Spanish tapas spread, Paella cooked on board, sushi platters, BBQ, or a champagne brunch. All catering is arranged via our team; prices are on request.

Can we bring our own food and drink on the yacht?

No, outside food and drink are not permitted. Our all-inclusive packages cover drinks and snacks, and we offer a range of catering upgrades to suit your party. This ensures quality and safety on board.

How much does a hen party yacht charter cost in Marbella for 2027?

Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) and go up to €4,719 for 4 hours on Tier B (Mangusta 80). Catering upgrades are extra. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT.

Which boats are best for a hen party of 10 to 12 people?

For groups of 10-12, we recommend the Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax), Mangusta 80 (12 pax), or Ferretti 94 (12 pax). These offer spacious decks, sunbathing areas, and comfort for a party atmosphere.

What themes can we choose for a 2027 hen party on a yacht?

Popular themes include a White Party (all-white dress code with champagne), Flamenco Fiesta (Spanish music and tapas), Ibiza Boat Party (DJ and glow sticks), or a luxury brunch with Prosecco and pastries. We can tailor the menu and decorations.

What extras can we add to a hen party yacht charter?

Extras include jet ski (free with Mangusta 80), custom cakes, decorations, a photographer, DJ equipment, and themed tableware. All extras are priced on request and must be arranged in advance.
